evidence_boundary.allocation: Observed route histories are policy-selected. Abandoned routes are right-censored, so their counterfactual continuation value is not identified by these logs.
evidence_boundary.proposal: Intent comparisons in complete search are confounded by selected anchors and downstream allocation. Static code mechanism tags are an interpretable proxy, not a validated semantic family label.

history_effect_conditions.boundary: Quality strata were built into the paired probe. Correlations with path features are post hoc, use only 18 anchors per task, and are descriptive rather than validated effect modifiers.
